name: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library
whatYouGet: A free, age-appropriate book mailed monthly to enrolled children from birth to age 5.
eligibility: Children from birth to age 5 living in an area served by a local Imagination Library program; rules are set locally.
region: Varies by area (some states have statewide coverage)
catches: Availability depends on whether a local program covers your address. One local program notes the first book can take 8-10 weeks.
